lead_editorial.title: 22 Bhartiyon ki maut ek chetavni hai — Gulf mein rehne aur samundar par kaam karne waalon ki suraksha ab sabse badi praathmikta ho
lead_editorial.summary: Videsh mantralay ke mutabik West Asia ke sangharsh mein ab tak 22 Bhartiya maare gaye hain, jinmein 14 seafarers hain. Diplomacy ki apeel zaroori hai, par usse aage thos suraksha intezaam ki zaroorat hai.
body: Videsh mantralay ke pravakta Randhir Jaiswal ne Budhvaar ki briefing mein bataya ki February se chal rahe West Asia ke sangharsh mein ab tak 22 Bhartiya nagrikon ki jaan ja chuki hai, jinmein 14 seafarers hain. The Tribune ki report ke mutabik inmein se teen maut Saudi Arabia mein hui. Yeh aankda sirf ek sankhya nahi — har naam ke peechhe ek parivaar hai jo rozi-roti ke liye Gulf ya samundar par kaam karne gaye apne kisi apne ka intezaar kar raha tha.

Sangharsh US aur Israel ke Iran par hamlon se shuru hua tha, aur ab Houthi hamle Saudi Arabia ke tel dhaanche tak pahunch gaye hain. Report ke mutabik Houthis ne Saudi ki East-West pipeline ko nishana banaya, jo Hormuz mein rukawat ke baad Saudi tel ka ek ahem vikalp ban gayi thi. Isse Bab-el-Mandeb jaise samudri raaston ki suraksha par bhi sawaal uthe hain — wahi raaste jin par Bhartiya crew waale jahaaz roz guzarte hain.

Sarkar ne gehri chinta jatayi hai, Gulf mein Bhartiya samudaay se sampark mein rehne ki baat kahi hai aur Saudi naagrik dhaanche par Houthi hamlon ki aalochna ki hai. Hamari raay mein yeh sahi disha hai, lekin ab zaroorat aur thos kadmon ki hai: shipping companiyon ke saath milkar khatarnaak raaston par crew ki suraksha ke niyam, seafarers ke parivaaron ke liye ek saaf helpline aur muaavze ki tez prakriya, aur zaroorat padne par samay rehte nikaasi ki yojana.

India ke lakhon log Gulf mein kaam karte hain aur duniya ke shipping crew mein Bhartiyon ka bada hissa hai. Isliye yeh sangharsh hamare liye sirf tel ki keemat ya bazaar ka sawaal nahi, seedha insaani sawaal hai. Dialogue aur diplomacy ki apeel apni jagah zaroori hai — par jab tak shanti nahi aati, har Bhartiya ki suraksha ko neeti ke kendra mein rakhna hoga.

stories.title: West Asia sangharsh mein ab tak 22 Bhartiyon ki maut, inmein 14 seafarers: Videsh mantralay
stories.summary: MEA pravakta Randhir Jaiswal ne kaha ki India sangharsh ko lekar 'gehri chinta' mein hai; Saudi Arabia mein teen Bhartiyon ki jaan gayi. Sarkar ne Houthi hamlon ki aalochna ki.
body: Videsh mantralay (MEA) ke pravakta Randhir Jaiswal ne Budhvaar ko apni niyamit media briefing mein bataya ki West Asia mein jaari sangharsh mein ab tak 22 Bhartiya nagrik maare gaye hain, jinmein 14 seafarers shaamil hain. The Tribune ki report ke mutabik inmein se teen maut Saudi Arabia mein hui hain. Jaiswal ne kaha ki India is sangharsh ko lekar gehri chinta mein hai aur Gulf mein rehne waale Bhartiya samudaay ki suraksha aur bhalaai ke liye unse lagaataar sampark mein hai.

Yeh sangharsh February mein US aur Israel ke Iran par hamlon ke baad shuru hua tha aur haal mein Yemen ke Houthi group ke Saudi Arabia par hamlon se aur bhadka hai. Report ke mutabik Houthis ne Saudi ki East-West tel pipeline par hamla kiya, jo Strait of Hormuz se shipping baadhit hone ke baad Saudi tel export ka ek ahem raasta ban gayi thi. Isse Red Sea ko Gulf of Aden se jodne waale Bab-el-Mandeb strait ki suraksha par bhi chinta badhi hai.

India ne Saudi Arabia ke naagrik dhaanche aur aarthik thikaanon par Houthi hamlon ki aalochna karte hue kaha ki aise hamle kshetriya sthirata ko kamzor karte hain aur samudri aawajahi ki aazaadi ko khatre mein daalte hain. New Delhi ne ek baar phir baatcheet aur diplomacy ke zariye hal nikaalne ki apeel ki hai. Report mein ghayalon ya nikaasi ke aankde nahi diye gaye.

stories.title: Cabinet ne Rs 7,395 crore ki PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana ko di manzoori; 2.55 lakh panchayaton aur 32 lakh jan-pratinidhiyon ko milega fayda
stories.summary: 2026-27 se 2030-31 tak chalne waali yojana mein Centre ka hissa Rs 4,869 crore aur rajyon ka Rs 2,526 crore hoga; panchayat vikas yojana, training aur online audit par zor.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ki adhyakshata mein Union Cabinet ne Budhvaar ko Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PM VGSY) ko manzoori di. The Hans India mein chhapi IANS report ke mutabik is Centrally Sponsored Scheme ka kul kharch Rs 7,395.55 crore hai — jismein Centre ka hissa Rs 4,869.48 crore aur rajyon ka Rs 2,526.07 crore hoga. Yojana 2026-27 se 2030-31 tak, yaani Solahven Vitt Aayog ki avadhi ke saath chalegi.

Yojana ke tahat har saal 2.55 lakh Gram Panchayat Development Plans eGramSwaraj portal par taiyaar karne mein madad di jayegi, aur lagbhag 32 lakh chune hue pratinidhiyon va panchayat karmchaariyon ki training aur digital handholding hogi. Har saal kam se kam 2.55 lakh online audit plan banaye jayenge aur AuditOnline ke zariye audit poora kiya jayega; saath hi panchayaton ki apni kamaai (Own Source Revenue) badhane par bhi zor rahega. Har jaagrukta abhiyan ka lakshya kam se kam 1 crore naagrikon tak pahunchna hai.

Report ke mutabik yojana mein koi naya sthaayi pad nahi banaya jayega; zaroorat ke hisaab se rajya, zila aur block star par contract staff rakha ja sakega. Yeh sabhi rajyon aur UTs mein laagu hogi, un ilaakon samet jahan panchayatein nahi hain. Isi din Cabinet ne kendriya karmchaariyon ke DA mein 3% badhotri aur Rs 1,856 crore ki Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme ko bhi manzoori di.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab: NDRF ke mutabik kam se kam teen ki maut, Andhra-Odisha se 1.8 lakh se zyada log surakshit jagahon par; aaj kai rajyon mein bhaari baarish ka alert
stories.summary: CM Naidu ne Amit Shah ko likhe patra mein 180 ghar tootne aur 220 ped girne ki jaankari di; Odisha ne 'zero casualty' lakshya poora karne ki baat kahi. Andaman Sagar mein naya low pressure banne ki sambhavana.
body: Very severe cyclonic storm Arnab ke Andhra Pradesh mein landfall ke baad NDRF adhikari Narendra Singh Bundela ne ABC News ko bataya ki toofan mein kam se kam teen logon ki jaan gayi hai. Report ke mutabik Andhra Pradesh aur Odisha se 1.8 lakh se zyada logon ko surakshit jagahon par pahunchaya gaya. Mukhyamantri N Chandrababu Naidu ne Kendriya Grih Mantri Amit Shah ko likhe patra mein bataya ki kam se kam 180 ghar toote aur 220 ped gire. Civil aviation mantralay ke mutabik Andhra ke teen airports par kaamkaaj roka gaya tha.

Odisha mein Mukhyamantri Mohan Charan Majhi ne nuksaan ka jaayza lene ke liye high-level baithak ki. TNI ki report ke mutabik rajya ne apna 'zero casualty' lakshya poora kiya — 43,827 logon ko 634 relief shelters mein rakha gaya. 50 se zyada trainein radd hui aur kai udaanein prabhavit rahin. Bundela ke mutabik Odisha par Andhra jitna asar nahi pada.

Toofan ab zameen par kamzor ho raha hai, lekin iska asar door tak dikhega. IMD ne Guruvaar ke liye Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, poorvi MP aur poorvi UP mein kahin-kahin bhaari se bahut bhaari baarish ki chetavni di hai, jabki Delhi, Haryana, Punjab aur poorvi Rajasthan mein olon ke saath aandhi ki sambhavana hai. TNI ke mutabik IMD ne Andaman Sagar mein ek naya low pressure kshetra banne ki sambhavana bhi jatayi hai.

editorial.title: Panchayaton ko paisa hi nahi, kaabiliyat bhi chahiye — VGSY ki asli kasauti audit aur paardarshita hogi
body: Solahven Vitt Aayog ne gramin sthaaniya nikaayon ke liye paanch saal mein lagbhag Rs 4.35 lakh crore ke grant ki sifaarish ki hai. Itni badi rakam sahi jagah pahunche, iske liye panchayaton ki yojana banane aur hisaab rakhne ki kshamta majboot karna zaroori hai — aur PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana isi kami ko bharne ki koshish dikhti hai.

Hamari raay mein yojana ka sabse achha hissa online audit aur public disclosure par zor hai. Gaon ke log jab dekh sakenge ki paisa kahan aur kaise kharch hua, tab hi Gram Sabha sachmuch jawabdehi maang paayegi. Training ka lakshya bhi bada hai — 32 lakh pratinidhi har saal.

Lekin kasauti kaagaz par lakshya nahi, zameen par natije honge. Training rasmi na rahe, audit samay par aur saarvajanik hon, aur panchayaton ko apni kamaai badhane ki asli aazaadi mile — tabhi 'Gram Swaraj' naam sirf naara nahi, haqeeqat banega.

stories.title: Spain mein do high-speed trainon ki takkar, kam se kam 68 logon ki maut; Toledo ke paas peechhe se lagi takkar, dibbe khaai mein gire
stories.summary: Madrid–Andalusia line par Renfe aur Iryo ki trainein takrayin; 15 log gambhir roop se ghayal, 50 se zyada aspataal mein. Hadse ki vajah ki jaanch jaari.
body: Spain ke Castilla-La Mancha kshetra mein Toledo ke paas Budhvaar subah do high-speed trainon ki takkar mein kam se kam 68 logon ki maut ho gayi. ABC News ki report ke mutabik kshetriya president Emiliano Garcia-Page ne bataya ki 24 maut Renfe train mein aur baaki Iryo train mein hui, aur adhikariyon ko aankda badhne ki aashanka hai. Kam se kam 15 log gambhir roop se ghayal hain aur 50 se zyada log halki chot ke saath aspataal mein bharti hain.

RTE par chhapi Reuters report ke mutabik hadsa sthaaniya samay ke hisaab se subah 9 baje ke kuch der baad Urda aur Los Yébenes ke beech hua. Rail operator Adif ne ise 'do trainon ki peechhe se takkar' bataya aur Madrid–Andalusia high-speed line par aawajahi rok di. ABC (Australia) ke mutabik Iryo train mein lagbhag 147 aur Renfe train mein 397 yaatri savaar the; do dibbe patri se utarkar dhalaan se neeche gir gaye.

Shuruaati jaankari ke mutabik Renfe train ne khadi Iryo train ko peechhe se takkar maari, lekin hadse ki asli vajah abhi saaf nahi hai. Swasthya mantri Mónica García ne ise 'tragedy' bataya. Gauratlab hai ki isi saal January mein bhi Spain mein ek high-speed rail hadse mein 45 log maare gaye the.

image.alt: Madrid mein Iryo ki ek high-speed train (file photo, hadse ki tasveer nahi)

stories.title: Israel: official ginti mein Netanyahu bloc 53, vipaksh 48 seat par; Golan ne Arab dalon ke saath sarkar ki apeel ki, Likud ne dhaandhli ke aarop lagaye
stories.summary: Kisi bloc ko 61 seat ka bahumat nahi; Arab dalon ko record 19 seat. Double-envelope votes raat bhar gine gaye, jo natije badal sakte hain.
body: Israel ke Central Elections Committee ke Budhvaar shaam jaari official aankdon mein Benjamin Netanyahu ka right-wing aur dharmik bloc 53 seat par aur vipakshi bloc 48 seat par raha. The Jerusalem Post ke mutabik 120 seat waali Knesset mein bahumat ke liye 61 seat chahiye, aur Arab dalon ne milkar record 19 seat jeeti hain. Likud 26 seat ke saath sabse badi party hai, jabki Gadi Eisenkot ki Yashar 21 aur Naftali Bennett ki B'Yachad 12 seat par hai.

Ginti lagbhag 88% poori hone ke baad double-envelope ballots — jinmein sainik, aspataal ke mareez aur kuch election karmi shaamil hain — raat bhar gine jaane the, aur report ke mutabik yeh natije badal sakte hain. Ynet ke mutabik aise 5 lakh se zyada vote hain aur unki ginti Guruvaar shaam tak chal sakti hai. Democrats ke neta Yair Golan ne kaha ki woh Guruvaar ko teen vipakshi netaon se milenge aur vipaksh ko Arab dalon ke saath sarkar banani chahiye.

Doosri taraf Eisenkot Netanyahu ke neeche kaam karne se inkaar kar chuke hain, aur Bennett samet zyaadatar vipakshi neta Arab dalon ko sarkar mein shaamil karne ke khilaaf hain. Likud ne Arab dalon par dhaandhli, rishvat aur dhamkaane ke aarop lagakar jaanch ki maang ki hai — yeh abhi sirf aarop hain. President Isaac Herzog ne doosre chunav se bachne ki apeel ki hai.

image.alt: Jerusalem mein Israel ki sansad Knesset ki imaarat (file photo)

editorial.title: Israel ka janaadesh bikhra hua hai — dhaandhli ke aarop nahi, imaandaar coalition baatcheet hi raasta hai
body: Israel ke voters ne kisi ek kheme ko saaf bahumat nahi diya. Arab dalon ki record 19 seat ne ganit ko poori tarah badal diya hai, aur ab sarkar banane ka raasta in dalon ke rukh se hokar guzar sakta hai.

Hamari raay mein bina sabooton ke dhaandhli ke aarop lagana loktantrik prakriya par bharosa kamzor karta hai. Agar shikayatein hain, to unhe chunav aayog aur adaalat ke saamne thos tareeke se rakha jaana chahiye. Saath hi, vipaksh ko bhi tay karna hoga ki 'badlaav' ka vaada sirf Netanyahu-virodh tak seemit hai ya ek saajha karyakram bhi hai.

Saal bhar se chal rahe kshetriya sangharsh ke beech Israel ko ek sthir sarkar ki zaroorat hai. Ek aur chunav sabke liye mehnga hoga — isliye sabhi dalon ko Herzog ki 'open mind' waali apeel ko gambhirta se lena chahiye.

stories.title: US Fed ne byaaj dar 3.75–4% par sthir rakhi; 10-2 vote mein Lisa Cook aur Beth Hammack hike ke paksh mein, Warsh bole — December par abhi faisla nahi
stories.summary: September mein dar badhane ke baad Fed ne is baar rok lagayi; statement mein arthvyavastha ki raftaar 'strong' batayi gayi. Wall Street halki badhat ke saath band, 10-saal ki US yield 5.04% par.
body: US Federal Reserve ne Budhvaar ko apni benchmark byaaj dar ko 3.75% se 4% ke daayre mein sthir rakha, jaisi ummeed thi. Yahoo Finance ke live coverage ke mutabik faisla 10-2 ke vote se hua — Governor Lisa Cook aur Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack chahte the ki dar 0.25% aur badhayi jaaye. Fed ne September mein dar badhayi thi.

Fed ke statement mein arthvyavastha ki growth ko 'solid' se badhakar 'strong' bataya gaya, aur woh line hata di gayi jismein kaha gaya tha ki policy action 2% inflation ki taraf wapsi mein madad karega; ab kaha gaya hai ki aur jaankari se sahi policy tay karne mein madad milegi. Cappnotes ke market wrap ke mutabik Chair Kevin Warsh ne December meeting ke baare mein pehle se kuch kehne se inkaar kiya aur aane waale hafton ko jaankari se bharpoor bataya. Yahoo ke mutabik Warsh ne kaha ki 2027 ki ek meeting sirf lambi avadhi ki strategy par hogi.

Faisle ke baad S&P 500 0.28% chadhkar 7,743.98 par, Nasdaq 0.27% badhkar 26,549.85 par aur Dow 0.19% badhkar 52,475.10 par band hua. 10-saal ki US Treasury yield 5.2 basis point chadhkar 5.044% par pahunchi. Tel ki keematein bhi upar rahin — Brent 1.26% badhkar $115.32 aur WTI 2.88% badhkar $102.78 prati barrel par settle hua.

image.alt: US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh (file photo)

stories.title: Aaj ka bazaar: Fed ke faisle aur $115 ke Brent ke beech Sensex-Nifty ke range-bound rehne ka anuman; Nifty ke liye 22,500 support
stories.summary: Budhvaar ko Nifty 0.22% girkar 22,698 aur Sensex 0.48% girkar 73,246 par band hua tha. Analysts ke mutabik 22,800–22,830 ke upar nikalne par hi tezi ka raasta khulega.
body: Goodreturns ki market outlook report ke mutabik Budhvaar ko Fed ke faisle se pehle Nifty 50 0.22% girkar 22,698 aur BSE Sensex 0.48% girkar 73,246 par band hua tha. Bank Nifty din mein 53,626 ke nichle star tak jaakar lagbhag 54,250 par band hua. Report ke mutabik Nifty ke liye 22,800–22,830 ke aas-paas resistance aur 22,500 par support hai.

Raat mein US Fed ne dar sthir rakhi, lekin do sadasyon ke hike ke paksh mein vote dene aur 10-saal ki US yield ke 5% ke upar rehne se global bazaar mein saavdhaani bani hui hai. Brent crude $115 ke upar settle hua, jo India jaise tel aayaatak desh ke liye chinta ki baat hai. Motilal Oswal ke Siddhartha Khemka ne report mein kaha tha ki Bhartiya shares ke range-bound rehne ki sambhavana hai.
Niveshakon ki nazar aaj Alphabet ke kamzor natijon ke baad tech shares par, rupaye ki chaal par aur tel ki keemat par rahegi. (Yeh jaankari sirf khabar hai, nivesh salah nahi.)

stories.title: Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme ko Cabinet ki manzoori: 8 saal mein Rs 1,856 crore, khel saamaan banane mein India ko global player banane ka lakshya
stories.summary: FY27 se FY34 tak chalne waali yojana mein manufacturing zones, anchor nivesh aur turnover-linked sahayata ke saath testing, research aur skill development par kharch hoga.
body: Kendra sarkar ne Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme ko manzoori di hai, jiska kul kharch Rs 1,856 crore hai. Business Today ki report ke mutabik yojana aath saal — FY 2026-27 se FY 2033-34 tak — chalegi aur iska maqsad global sports equipment bazaar mein India ki pratispardhi kshamta badhana hai.

Yojana ke do mukhya hisse hain. Pehla, manufacturing incentives — jismein dedicated manufacturing zones, anchor nivesh, yogya nirmaataon ko turnover se judi sahayata aur maujooda clusters ko madad shaamil hai. Doosra, ecosystem par kaam — certification aur testing suvidhaayein, research, skill development, start-ups aur branding.

Report mein sahayata ki daron, naukriyon ya export ke lakshyon ka zikr nahi hai. India mein Jalandhar aur Meerut jaise shahar pehle se khel saamaan ke bade kendra maane jaate hain, aur udyog ko is yojana se nivesh badhne ki ummeed hai.

editorial.title: Fed ruka hai, par khatra tala nahi — mehnga tel aur oonchi US yield India ke liye do-tarfa dabaav hain
body: Fed ka dar na badhana raahat jaisa lagta hai, lekin 10-2 ka vote aur do sadasyon ka hike ki taraf jhukaav batata hai ki US mein mehngaai ki chinta abhi khatm nahi hui. 10-saal ki US yield ka 5% ke upar rehna duniya bhar ke bazaar se paisa US ki taraf kheench sakta hai.
India ke liye yeh dabaav Brent ke $115 ke saath milkar aur bhaari ho jaata hai. Mehnga tel aayaat bill badhata hai, rupaye par dabaav daalta hai aur aage mehngaai ka khatra paida karta hai.

Hamari raay mein aise samay mein RBI aur sarkar dono ko saavdhaan aur saaf sanket dene honge — fiscal anushaasan bana rahe aur tel ke jhatke se aam aadmi ko bachane ke upaay lakshit hon. Niveshakon ke liye bhi yeh dhairya ka waqt hai, ghabraahat ka nahi.

stories.title: World Wrestling Championships: Kajal Dhochak aur Neelam Sirohi ne jeeta silver, ek hi edition mein do silver jeetne waali pehli Bhartiya mahilayen
stories.summary: Astana mein 18 saal ki Kajal (76kg) final mein Ukraine ki Alpyeyeva se 4-8 se haari; Neelam ko Japan ki Yui Susaki ne pin kiya. 2021 mein Anshu Malik ke baad India ka pehla World silver.
body: Kazakhstan ke Astana mein chal rahi World Wrestling Championships mein Bhartiya pehalwaan Kajal Dhochak aur Neelam Sirohi ne silver medal jeete. The Bridge ki report ke mutabik yeh pehli baar hai jab ek hi edition mein do Bhartiya mahilaon ne silver jeeta hai, aur 2021 mein Anshu Malik ke 57kg silver ke baad yeh India ka pehla World Championships silver hai. Ab tak Anshu hi World final tak pahunchne waali akeli Bhartiya mahila thin — ab yeh sankhya teen ho gayi hai.

18 saal ki Kajal (76kg) ne semifinal mein Kyrgyzstan ki Aiperi Medet Kyzy ke khilaaf 1-7 se peechhe hone ke baad shaandaar wapsi karte hue 10-7 se jeet darj ki. Final mein Ukraine ki Anastasiya Alpyeyeva ke khilaaf aakhri 35 second tak score 4-4 tha aur Kajal criteria par aage thin, lekin Alpyeyeva ne lagaataar do do-point move lagakar 8-4 se mukaabla jeet liya.

Neelam Sirohi ne semifinal mein mezbaan Kazakhstan ki Zeinep Bayanova ko 7-3 se haraya, lekin final mein Japan ki Yui Susaki ne unhe pehle period mein hi pin kar diya. Doosri taraf Rajnita (65kg) repechage mein Japan ki Nana Ikehata se 2-6 se haarkar bronze ki daud se bahar ho gayin.

stories.title: AI kharch ki keemat: Alphabet ke natije anumaan se kamzor, share after-hours mein 10% gira; Microsoft ka Azure 48% badha, share chadha
stories.summary: Alphabet ka capex 114% badhkar $51.36 billion, free cash flow $9.07 billion ke ghaate mein; Google Cloud revenue double hokar $30.71 billion. Microsoft ka revenue $92.28 billion, anumaan se upar.
body: Google ki parent company Alphabet ke teesri timaahi ke natije Wall Street ke anumaan se kamzor rahe. BigGo Finance ki report ke mutabik company ka revenue 25% badhkar $127.58 billion raha, jo $128.22 billion ke anumaan se thoda kam hai, aur adjusted EPS $2.67 raha jabki ummeed $3.02 ki thi. Cappnotes ke mutabik lagbhag chaar saal mein yeh pehla mauka hai jab company revenue aur munafe dono par chooki, aur share after-hours trading mein lagbhag 10% gir gaya.

Kamzori ki badi vajah AI par bhaari kharch dikhi: Alphabet ka capital expenditure saal-dar-saal 114% badhkar $51.36 billion ho gaya aur free cash flow pichhle saal ke $24.46 billion ke munafe se palatkar $9.07 billion ke ghaate mein chala gaya. Haalaanki Google Cloud ka revenue 103% badhkar $30.71 billion pahunch gaya, jo anumaan se behtar tha.

Doosri taraf Microsoft ne July-September timaahi mein $92.28 billion ka revenue darj kiya, jo $90.69 billion ke anumaan se upar hai. Report ke mutabik Azure revenue 48% badhkar $33.17 billion raha, aur company ka capex $45.2 billion raha jo analysts ke anumaan se kam tha. Natijon ke baad Microsoft ka share after-hours mein lagbhag 3-4% chadha.

stories.title: Rajinikanth ki 'Jailer 2' ka box office par dabdaba: 12 din mein worldwide Rs 735 crore gross ke paar
stories.summary: Bollywood Hungama ke mutabik film saal ki sabse badi theatrical hit filmon mein; Sacnilk ke mutabik 13 din mein India net collection Rs 415 crore se zyada.
body: Superstar Rajinikanth ki action film 'Jailer 2' ne release ke 12 din mein worldwide gross collection mein Rs 735 crore ka aankda paar kar liya hai. Bollywood Hungama ki report ke mutabik film India ke saath-saath videshon mein bhi darshakon ko kheench rahi hai aur saal ki sabse badi theatrical kaamyaabiyon mein gini ja rahi hai.

Box office tracking site Sacnilk ke mutabik film ne 13ven din India mein Rs 7.50 crore net kamaaye, jisse iska kul India net collection Rs 415.65 crore ho gaya. Film ki raftaar ab dheemi pad rahi hai, lekin weekdays mein bhi iska collection mazboot bana hua hai.

Aane waale hafton mein box office par badi takkar dekhne ko milegi — 5 November ko Ranbir Kapoor ki 'Ramayana' release ho rahi hai, jiski wajah se kai filmon ne apni release taarikhein aage badha di hain.

image.alt: Dadasaheb Phalke Award samaaroh mein Rajinikanth (file photo)

editorial.title: Kajal aur Neelam ke silver mahila kushti ki nayi peedhi ka elaan hain — ab inhe sahi support ka intezaar na karna pade
body: 18 saal ki Kajal ka 1-7 se wapsi karke final tak pahunchna aur aakhri second tak gold ke kareeb rehna dikhata hai ki Bhartiya mahila kushti mein nayi peedhi taiyaar hai. Paanch saal ke intezaar ke baad do silver ek saath aana chhoti baat nahi.

Hamari raay mein ab asli kaam medal ke baad shuru hota hai — videshi training, behtar sparring partner, sports science aur chot se bachaav. Final mein aakhri pal ki chook aksar anubhav aur fitness ka farq hoti hai, jo nirantar international exposure se hi aata hai.

Federation aur sarkar ko in khiladiyon ko agle Olympic chakra ke liye lambi avadhi ki yojana mein shaamil karna chahiye. Silver ko gold mein badalne ka raasta saaf hai — bas samarthan bina rukawat ke milta rahe.
